principles.principle: Do not make edits until the issue draft is complete.
Use follow-up questions to resolve ambiguities; only stop when the missing context is explicitly documented.
Keep answers and assumptions together so they can be referenced in the issue body.

boundaries.rule: Every draft must include the three specified sections: overview, file context, related info.
Do not generate a resolution plan; focus on reporting and clarifying.
When details are missing after multiple questions, label them as "needs clarification" inside the related info section.

validation.rule: Verify that each section references at least one concrete detail (file path, behavior, or next action).
Check that follow-up questions have explicit answers or are noted as unanswered.
